items.zh: 今晚你也要留下来加班吗？
items.scene: 下班前，隔壁组的人边关电脑边问你

answers.en: Are you staying late tonight too?
answers.note: 最随意的问法，只说晚点走，不一定是正式加班，平级之间常用。

answers.en: Do you have to work overtime tonight as well?
answers.note: have to 带出被要求、没得选的意味，比 staying late 多了无奈。

answers.en: Are you putting in extra hours tonight too?
answers.note: put in extra hours 是口语说法，突出多花的时间，熟人之间随口用。

items.zh: 老板又让你今晚留下来改方案？
items.scene: 同事看到老板刚从你工位走开

answers.en: Did the boss ask you to stay late and rework the proposal again?
answers.note: 中性转述老板的要求，只确认事实，不带情绪，适合普通同事。

answers.en: Is the boss making you stay tonight to redo the proposal again?
answers.note: making you 强调是被迫留下，替对方鸣不平的意味更明显。

answers.en: The boss wants you to stick around tonight and fix the proposal again?
answers.note: 用陈述句升调反问，stick around 指留在公司不走，关系近才这么说。

items.zh: 这个截止日期能往后推两天吗？
items.scene: 项目会上，你看向客户方的负责人

answers.en: Can we push the deadline back by two days?
answers.note: 最直接的标准说法，push back 就是往后推，会议和邮件都能用。

answers.en: Could we get a two-day extension?
answers.note: 把请求说成一个正式的延期，语气客气，适合对客户或上级。

answers.en: Any chance we could have two more days?
answers.note: 用 Any chance 开头，姿态最低，对方拒绝起来也容易开口。

items.zh: 这个项目还能按原计划上线吗？
items.scene: 周会上，你问项目负责人

answers.en: Are we still on track to launch as planned?
answers.note: on track 是项目管理常用说法，问整体进度有没有偏离计划。

answers.en: Can we still hit the original launch date?
answers.note: hit the date 更口语，焦点放在能不能赶上那个具体日期。

answers.en: Is the launch still happening on schedule?
answers.note: 重点在上线还按不按原计划走，暗示你听到了一些不确定的消息。

items.zh: 项目是不是要延期了？
items.scene: 加班时，同事压低声音问你

answers.en: Is the project running behind schedule?
answers.note: running behind schedule 是中性说法，问进度有没有落后，不带情绪。

answers.en: Are we going to miss the deadline?
answers.note: 直接问会不会错过截止时间，把担心摊开说，语气更急。

answers.en: Is the project falling behind?
answers.note: falling behind 更口语，像随口一问，压力感没那么重。

items.zh: 老板怎么又在群里问进度？
items.scene: 午休时，坐你对面的同事把手机递给你看

answers.en: Why is the boss asking about progress in the group chat again?
answers.note: 完整问句，语气偏中性，只在确认老板为什么又来问。

answers.en: Why's the boss checking in on progress again?
answers.note: 缩写加 checking in，更口语，带一点不耐烦。

answers.en: Why's the boss breathing down our necks about progress again?
answers.note: breathing down our necks 是习语，画面感强，抱怨意味最重。

items.zh: 报告还差设计部的数据，能再宽限半天吗？
items.scene: 老板站在桌边催你交报告

answers.en: I'm still waiting on the data from design—can I have another half day?
answers.note: 先说明卡在设计部，再提出请求，听起来有理有据，适合对老板。

answers.en: Could I get until tomorrow morning? Design hasn't sent the data yet.
answers.note: 把请求说成要到明早，先给期限再解释卡在哪，语气客气。

answers.en: I just need the design data—can you give me until noon?
answers.note: 最短最直接，点明只要数据就能交，适合沟通干脆的老板。

items.zh: 这周六是不是所有人都得来？
items.scene: 周五下班前，同事在群里问你

answers.en: Is everyone supposed to come in this Saturday?
answers.note: supposed to 问的是公司的安排，不针对某个人，语气中性。

answers.en: Do all of us have to be in on Saturday?
answers.note: have to be in 直接问义务，关心的是自己能不能不去。

answers.en: Are they expecting the whole team in on Saturday?
answers.note: 用 they 指公司，避开老板，适合不想把话说得太冲的时候。

items.zh: 你周日也来公司加班？
items.scene: 周六晚上，你在楼道碰到隔壁组的人

answers.en: You're coming in to work on Sunday too?
answers.note: 用进行时反问，带着已经猜到答案的惊讶，重点在你也要来。

answers.en: Are you working this Sunday as well?
answers.note: 中性问法，只确认对方周日是否上班，听不出惊讶。

answers.en: They've got you coming in on Sunday too?
answers.note: They've got you 暗示是被安排来的，带同情，适合一起吐槽公司。

items.zh: 我下周五能调休一天吗？
items.scene: 你给主管发消息申请下周调休

answers.en: Could I take next Friday off as comp time?
answers.note: comp time 是加班换来的调休，说法清楚，主管一听就懂。

answers.en: I'd like to use a comp day next Friday—is that okay?
answers.note: 先说明想用调休再问行不行，比直接请求更客气。

answers.en: Could I take next Friday off to make up for the overtime?
answers.note: 把补加班的原因说出来，适合主管需要你解释缘由时。

items.zh: 这次加班是给钱还是给调休？
items.scene: 加班到九点，你问旁边的人事同事

answers.en: Is this overtime paid, or do we get comp time?
answers.note: 把两种选项并列问清楚，语气中性，适合正式确认制度。

answers.en: Are we getting paid for this, or just time off later?
answers.note: 更口语，just 暗示你觉得可能只有调休，带一点怀疑。

answers.en: Does this count as paid overtime, or does it go toward comp time?
answers.note: 用 count as 和 go toward 说制度，措辞正式，适合问人事。

items.zh: 你最近是不是忙得脚不沾地？
items.scene: 电梯里，隔壁组的人盯着你的黑眼圈看

answers.en: Have you been swamped at work lately?
answers.note: 最常用的问法，swamped 指被工作淹没，问的是工作量大不大。

answers.en: You've been going nonstop—do you ever get a break?
answers.note: 从对方没停下来的状态入手，关心有没有休息，比问工作量更贴心。

answers.en: How are you holding up with everything on your plate?
answers.note: 用 hold up 问对方撑不撑得住，语气最体贴，适合关系近的同事。

items.zh: 你最近是不是压力大到睡不着？
items.scene: 早上茶水间，财务部的同事给你倒咖啡

answers.en: Has the stress been keeping you up at night?
answers.note: keep you up at night 是固定说法，关心对方失眠，语气温和。

answers.en: Are you so stressed you can't sleep?
answers.note: 直接问是不是压力大到失眠，语气直，适合关系近的同事。

answers.en: Is work stress messing with your sleep?
answers.note: 把原因点到工作上，messing with 很口语，带一点心疼。

items.zh: 我手上活太多了，能分出去一部分吗？
items.scene: 一对一会上，你向主管开口

answers.en: I've got too much on my plate—can we hand some of it off?
answers.note: on my plate 是常用比喻，hand off 指把活转给别人，语气中性。

answers.en: Could we redistribute some of my workload? I'm at capacity.
answers.note: redistribute my workload 是正式说法，at capacity 说明已经满负荷。

answers.en: Is there any way to take a few things off my plate?
answers.note: Any way 开头最委婉，像在商量而不是要求，适合怕得罪主管时。

items.zh: 你有没有想过辞职？
items.scene: 深夜加班，同事突然问你

answers.en: Have you ever thought about quitting?
answers.note: 最中性的问法，只问有没有这个念头，不替对方下判断。

answers.en: How much longer do you see yourself staying here?
answers.note: 绕开辞职二字，问对方还打算待多久，适合试探或不想把话挑明。

answers.en: Do you ever think about just calling it quits?
answers.note: calling it quits 很口语，暗示彻底不干了，情绪最重。

items.zh: 你是不是已经提离职了？
items.scene: 茶水间，行政部的同事小声确认传闻

answers.en: Did you already put in your notice?
answers.note: put in your notice 是美式常用说法，问是否已经正式提出。

answers.en: Did you hand in your two weeks' notice?
answers.note: two weeks' notice 更具体，指美国常见的提前两周通知。

answers.en: Are you actually leaving?
answers.note: 最短最直接，重点在真的要走，带惊讶，适合关系近的同事。

items.zh: 我想跟你聊聊涨薪的事，方便吗？
items.scene: 绩效面谈后，你给主管发消息

answers.en: Can we talk about a raise when you have a minute?
answers.note: 先问有没有空，再说涨薪，语气自然，适合日常和主管开口。

answers.en: I'd like to discuss my compensation—is now a good time?
answers.note: compensation 比 raise 正式，范围也更大，可能包括奖金和福利。

answers.en: Do you have time to talk about my salary?
answers.note: 直接说 salary，简单明了，适合说话不绕弯的主管。

items.zh: 我两年没涨过工资了，这正常吗？
items.scene: 午饭时，你问带你的老同事

answers.en: I haven't gotten a raise in two years—is that normal?
answers.note: 陈述事实后再问是否正常，语气平静，适合先探口风。

answers.en: Should I be worried that I haven't had a raise in two years?
answers.note: 把问题变成要不要担心，像在征求同事意见，语气更私密。

answers.en: Two years with no raise—is that just how it is here?
answers.note: 重复两年没涨再反问，带无奈，适合关系好、能吐槽的同事。

items.zh: 这次绩效我是不是拿了个差评？
items.scene: 绩效结果出来后，你问主管

answers.en: Did I get a bad review this time?
answers.note: 直接问结果是不是差评，适合已经听到风声、想确认的人。

answers.en: How did my performance review come out?
answers.note: 中性问表现评估结果，不预设好坏，给主管留解释空间。

answers.en: Was my rating that bad this cycle?
answers.note: that bad 带预设，像是已经看到结果，只差对方确认。

items.zh: 今年年终奖还有戏吗？
items.scene: 年底聚餐，坐你旁边的同事小声问你

answers.en: Are we getting a bonus this year?
answers.note: 最直接的问法，只问今年有没有奖金，语气中性。

answers.en: Is there any chance of a year-end bonus this year?
answers.note: Any chance 让问题变软，暗示你觉得希望不大。

answers.en: Are they actually paying out bonuses this year?
answers.note: actually 带怀疑，像在问公司到底会不会真发，适合私下吐槽。

items.zh: 今晚能不能加个班把表做完？
items.scene: 主管在下班前走到你工位

answers.en: Could you stay late tonight and finish the spreadsheet?
answers.note: 标准礼貌请求，Could you 开头，语气不强硬，适合不想显得在压人。

answers.en: Any way you could knock out the spreadsheet tonight?
answers.note: knock out 指很快做完，语气轻松，适合平时说话随和的主管。

answers.en: I need the spreadsheet finished tonight—can you stay?
answers.note: 先说必须今晚完成，再问能不能留，压力直接给到对方。

items.zh: 加班到这么晚，要不要点个外卖？
items.scene: 晚上九点，组里还有一半人没走

answers.en: It's late—should we order takeout?
answers.note: 最随口的小建议，should we 不强加，适合大家都没主意时。

answers.en: Do you guys want to get some takeout while we work?
answers.note: 点明大家边工作边吃，Do you guys 很口语，适合团队氛围轻松时。

answers.en: How about we order something in?
answers.note: order something in 指叫外卖到公司，像顺口提议，语气最随意。

items.zh: 这么赶，我们来得及交吗？
items.scene: 交稿前一晚，你问同组的搭档

answers.en: Are we going to make it at this rate?
answers.note: at this rate 指按现在这个速度，问得中性，但透着担心。

answers.en: We're cutting it close—do you think we'll make it?
answers.note: cutting it close 是习语，先把风险说出来，再问能不能赶上。

answers.en: Is there any way we can finish on time?
answers.note: 直接问还有没有时间做完，焦点在解决办法，语气最平稳。

items.zh: 我快撑不住了，能请两天假吗？
items.scene: 连续加班一周后，你找主管谈话

answers.en: I'm running on empty—can I take a couple of days off?
answers.note: running on empty 指精力耗尽，画面具体，适合说明自己撑不住。

answers.en: I'm close to burning out. Could I take two days off?
answers.note: burning out 直接点出职业倦怠，比 running on empty 更明确。

answers.en: I need a break—can I take a couple of days?
answers.note: 只说需要休息，不解释细节，语气直接，适合和主管关系一般时。

items.zh: 公司是不是给你加钱留你了？
items.scene: 你提离职后，隔壁组的人私下问你

answers.en: Did they offer you more money to stay?
answers.note: 中性问法，只问公司有没有加钱留人，不带评价。

answers.en: Did the company make you a counteroffer?
answers.note: counteroffer 是正式说法，指公司为挽留你开出的新条件。

answers.en: So they're throwing money at you to stay?
answers.note: throwing money at 带调侃，暗示公司只想用钱解决，适合私下八卦。
